highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.1 collects m156 fixes for transformed geometry, clipping, displacement filters and native Vulkan synchronization.
highlights_body: The collected servicing changes keep managed APIs and dependency versions unchanged. Ganesh avoids stale atlas work after empty flushes, while Graphite respects render-pass clip capacity.

bullets.lead: Correct transformed shapes and displacement sampling
bullets.detail: Ellipse and rounded-rectangle stroke widths and corner radii map to the correct device-space axes; radii are clamped to prevent overlap. Displacement offset arithmetic now matches the float precision used to calculate filter bounds.

bullets.lead: Keep atlas and clip work within the current flush
bullets.detail: Ganesh advances draw tokens after empty flushes to avoid stale atlas work. Graphite counts clips still needing recording and warns and skips a draw if its full clip stack cannot fit a fresh render pass.

Native Ganesh submission now requires both queue submission and its requested fence wait to succeed. Asynchronous submission is unchanged; managed GRContext.Submit still returns void and does not expose a new failure result or exception.
